messages:
maya: quick Q — we need to show model fallback behaviour in Console analytics (per-route / per-model) but without blowing up quota/cost numbers. how do folks feel about sampling + a UI toggle?
eli: sampling sounds right. record fallbacks as a separate telemetry event rather than mixing into model.request so counts don't double.
sam: from UX: saved queries should remember the toggle (include fallbacks: on/off). default = off for cost preview, on for debugging views.
tessa: telemetry proposal: emit `model.fallback` event with fields {route_id, primary_model, fallback_model, reason, tokens_used, sample_rate}. keep sample_rate on event so we can scale.
raj: note: fallback can cross regions and capacity tiers. include `region` and `capacity_tier` metadata to correlate routing policies. otherwise console graphs will confuse ops.
eli: minimal payload example:
```
{
  "evt": "model.fallback",
  "route": "route_123",
  "primary": "redwood-v1",
  "fallback": "redwood-v1-quant",
  "reason": "capacity_limit",
  "tokens": 42,
  "sample_rate": 0.1
}
```
sam: UI: add a small pill on per-route cards "Fall back: 0.1% sampled" that opens a quick toggle and an explanation tooltip. saved-query meta stores `include_fallbacks` and `fallback_sample` so exports reproduce the view.
maya: good. one question — sampling affects accuracy of error rates/quality metrics. we need to surface confidence intervals or a note in the header.
tessa: agree. we can compute simple CI for binary metrics (e.g., fallback rate) based on sample counts and show margin. also add a link to raw samples for teams who want full resolution (subject to quota).
raj: platform concern: if someone turns on full fallback capture for a saved query and shares it org-wide, they could spike token usage. we should enforce an org-level guard and require an admin opt-in for >5% sample or full capture.
eli: we can gate via API param `telemetry.capture_level=org_default|opt_in|force` and surface a explanatory modal in Console when saved-query would exceed guardrails.
sam: UX for rollout: when rollouts include new fallback routing rules, Console should show a transient banner on affected route-views: "Fallbacks active (canary) — data sampled" with link to rollout page.
rollout-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/fallbacks-toggle -> prod @ 2024-03-05T16:00Z.
maya: action items: eli implement event schema + server-side sampling, raj add region/tier tags + guardrail enforcement, sam wire toggle + saved-query persistence, tessa add CI in analytics. i'll create a tiny RFC and assign owners. :thumbsup:
eli: sounds good, starting on schema PR.
sam: will mock the toggle + pill by EOD.
tessa: i'll add sample-rate CI calc to the analytics backlog.
raj: i'll draft the guardrail enforcement policy and config flags.
maya: thanks all — please drop PR/links in this thread when ready."
